CustomField.description: ADO 220029 AC1 - backend-only field (not on any page layout). Holds the intended Order status (Delivered/Ordered/Unfulfilled) when an order cannot be activated at header-upload time because Salesforce requires at least one Order Product. The Order Item Confirmation upload applies this status once products exist, then clears it.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Backend-only field used by the order upload to remember the intended status until the order has at least one product.
CustomField.label: Requested Status
